Name: Clover Cows
Author: Crowspiel
Description:
Includes Adult and Baby Variations. Basic Texture replacement, no gameplay changes.
Only Changes: Brown Cows. White ones remain unchanged.
Compatible with 1.6 and above.

[u]How to Install:[/u]
[list]
[*]Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
[*]Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[*]Download and Unzip files.
[*]Run SMAPI installation process if you haven't already.
[*]Move Files into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.
[/list][code]﻿C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods
[/code][list]
[*]Enjoy!
[/list]
Textures are based on VTuber @MooMooClover ,all credits and rights for the design base belong to them.
Sprite base credit belongs to @ConcernedApe.
Textures were done by me.
